title: Site on a phone
description: Your website on a phone: a phone drawn in CSS (no brand, no logo) rises from below, turns from a tilt to upright and its screen lights up with your tall screenshot or screen recording. The words stand beside it. The phone is 84 % of the slide height. For screens and results, not for portraits.

props.src: required, a tall picture (about 9:19.5) or a tall video (mp4/webm) of the screen
props.title: 2-6 words beside the phone
props.note: small line with a gold rule
props.tilt: how far the phone leans when it has landed, in degrees (-12 to 12, default 0 = upright)
props.side: left (default) or right: where the words go
props.poster: still shown before the video loads
